title: Jobs
activity_waiting_slots: Waiting for the model to be free
blocker_mqtt_pressure: Background work is slowed while camera events are busy
circuit_open_message: Video analysis is paused after repeated failures.
circuit_reset_confirm: Queued analysis will resume straight away.
circuit_reset_failed: The analysis could not be resumed. Try again; if it keeps failing, open Health.
backfill_status_unavailable: The status was lost when YA-WAMF restarted or your sign-in changed, so the job may have been interrupted. Start it again if its result is missing.
backfill_counts_visits: {added, plural, one {# visit added} other {# visits added}} · {updated, number} updated · {skipped, number} skipped · {errors, number} failed
backfill_counts_weather: {updated, number} updated · {skipped, number} skipped · {errors, number} failed
errors_backend_empty: The backend has recorded no warnings or errors since the error history was last cleared. Connection problems are listed at the top of this page, not here.
errors_export_failed: The diagnostics could not be read. Try again; if it keeps failing, check that YA-WAMF is running.
errors_export_desc: A bundle captures this page, the backend’s warnings and errors, the model’s status, start-up warnings and incidents as one JSON file. Attach one when you report a problem.
errors_export_notes_placeholder: What went wrong? Included in the bundle.
error_bundles_stats: {groups, plural, one {# group} other {# groups}} · {events, plural, one {# event} other {# events}} · {snapshots, plural, one {# snapshot} other {# snapshots}}
global_running_multi: {count, plural, one {# job running} other {# jobs running}}
errors_backend_diagnostics_desc: The newest the backend has recorded since the error history was last cleared.
errors_naming_labels_changed: The label file for {models} does not match the checksum it was published with. Species names taken from it are not trustworthy.
errors_naming_no_reference: No bundled species reference, so names come from the network only.
errors_naming_ok: {count, plural, one {# species can be named without the network.} other {# species can be named without the network.}}
errors_naming_catalog_missing: No species catalogue yet. Names come from the bundled reference and model label files.
errors_naming_catalog_empty: The species catalogue is empty. Names come from the bundled reference and model label files.
errors_naming_catalog_gaps: {unresolved} model output classes have no catalogue identity yet and keep their original label text.
errors_naming_catalog_ok: Every mapped model output resolves to a catalogue identity.
errors_catalog_rollback: The catalogue is a separate file from your visit history. Rolling one back changes names, never your recorded visits, and a backup of the data folder covers both.
errors_summary_degraded: Some parts are busy or recovering. YA-WAMF is still working.
errors_summary_faults: Something is failing and needs your attention. The problems are listed below.
errors_pipeline_ok: What Frigate sends is being processed normally.
errors_pipeline_critical: {count, plural, one {# critical failure recorded.} other {# critical failures recorded.}}
errors_pipeline_historical: {count, plural, one {# earlier failure recorded; processing has since recovered.} other {# earlier failures recorded; processing has since recovered.}}
errors_pipeline_dropped: {count, plural, one {# Frigate event was dropped by a fault.} other {# Frigate events were dropped by a fault.}}
errors_filtered_none: Nothing has been filtered out yet.
errors_filtered_summary: {count, plural, one {# Frigate event did not pass your identification settings.} other {# Frigate events did not pass your identification settings.}} This is the filter working, not a fault.
errors_filtered_hint: Lower the minimum confidence floor in Settings → Identifying birds to keep more of these as Unknown bird.
errors_activity_subtitle: Recorded visits, filtered events and faults, in the order they happened
errors_activity_no_window: This instance has not reported when it started, so activity cannot be placed in a window yet.
errors_activity_empty: No visits, filtered events or faults have been reported since this instance started {started} ago.
errors_activity_earlier: {count, plural, one {# earlier event in this window} other {# earlier events in this window}}
errors_fault_preview: Preview the frame that failed for {species}
errors_filtered_frame_gone: Frigate no longer has this frame

errors_drop_reason_row.filter_low_confidence: Not recorded, below your minimum confidence floor
errors_drop_reason_row.filter_below_threshold: Not recorded, below your naming threshold
errors_drop_reason_row.filter_blocked_label: Not recorded, this species is blocked
errors_drop_reason_row.filter_abstention_label: Not recorded, the model gave no name
errors_drop_reason_row.filter_invalid_score: Not recorded, the score was unusable
errors_drop_reason_row.filter_out_of_range: Not recorded, never seen in your eBird region

frigate_media_advisory_title: Frigate often has no snapshot for an event
frigate_media_advisory_body: {percent}% of recent Frigate events ({dropped} of {started}) were dropped because Frigate had no snapshot, thumbnail or recording for them. This usually means birds tracked too briefly for Frigate to keep, or recordings kept for too short a time.
errors_mqtt_ok: Messages are handled as they arrive.
errors_mqtt_pressure: The MQTT connection is under {pressure} load: {inFlight} of {capacity} messages being handled.
errors_mqtt_reconnected: MQTT is working again after {count, plural, one {# reconnect} other {# reconnects}}.
errors_live_class_ok: Nothing is waiting to be named.
errors_live_class_queued: {queued} waiting to be named, behind {running} of {maxConcurrent} running.
errors_background_throttled: Background work is held back, with {queued} waiting, so new visits are named first.
errors_dispatcher_ok: Notifications are being sent and the database is answering.
errors_dispatcher_dropped: {count, plural, one {# notification was not sent because too many were waiting.} other {# notifications were not sent because too many were waiting.}}
errors_dispatcher_db_wait: The longest wait for the database was {ms} ms.
errors_startup_summary: {count, plural, one {# start-up warning recorded.} other {# start-up warnings recorded.}} Latest step: {phase}.
more_lanes: +{count, plural, one {# more work lane} other {# more work lanes}}
errors_summary_connections_unread: Nothing inside YA-WAMF reports a fault, but the MQTT broker and Frigate connections could not be read.
errors_connections_unread: The connection could not be read. Refresh to try again.
errors_mqtt_disconnected: Not connected to {server}. Last tried {at}; it keeps retrying.

errors_frigate_failure.timeout: it took too long to answer
errors_frigate_failure.server_error: it reported an error of its own
errors_frigate_failure.connection: the address could not be reached

errors_frigate_unreachable: Frigate at {url} did not answer at {at}: {reason}.
errors_frigate_unchecked: Frigate at {url} has not been asked anything since this instance started.
errors_frigate_announced_online: Frigate announces itself online over MQTT.
errors_frigate_announced_offline: Frigate announces itself offline over MQTT.
errors_pipeline_idle: Nothing has arrived from Frigate since this instance started.

errors_problem.mqtt_down: The MQTT broker at {server} is not connected, so no new visits can be recorded.
errors_problem.mqtt_down_next: Check its address in Settings → Cameras & connection and that the broker is running.
errors_problem.mqtt_not_configured: No MQTT broker is set, so no visits can be recorded.
errors_problem.mqtt_not_configured_next: Add one in Settings → Cameras & connection.
errors_problem.mqtt_stopped: The MQTT service is not running, so no new visits can be recorded.
errors_problem.mqtt_stopped_next: Restart YA-WAMF to start it again.
errors_problem.frigate_down: Frigate at {url} is not answering, so new visits cannot be saved.
errors_problem.frigate_down_next: Check its address in Settings → Cameras & connection and that Frigate is running.
errors_problem.model_missing: The chosen identification model is not on this install, so no bird can be named.
errors_problem.model_missing_next: Download it, or choose one that is installed, in Settings → Identifying birds.

errors_clear_effect: Removes recorded errors and incidents now. Live checks carry on.
earlier_incidents_desc: Problems that have since cleared. What is open now is listed with the system status above.
earlier_incidents_empty: Nothing has cleared since the error history was last cleared.
global_queued_only: {count, plural, one {# job queued} other {# jobs queued}}
errors_read_failed: The health reading could not be loaded, so this page claims no state.
errors_read_failed_next: Refresh to try again. If it keeps failing, check that the YA-WAMF backend is running.
errors_read_stale: The latest refresh failed, so this is the reading from {at}. Refresh to try again.
errors_pipeline_unmeasured: Nothing can arrive while the MQTT broker is not connected, so these counts do not show whether processing works.
errors_mqtt_cause_unknown: The broker client gave a reason YA-WAMF does not recognise. It is shown under Technical details.
errors_video_paused_until: Video analysis is paused until {at}, after {count, plural, one {# failure} other {# failures}} in a row.
errors_video_paused: Video analysis is paused after {count, plural, one {# failure} other {# failures}} in a row.
errors_video_not_paused: Video analysis is not paused: {queued} waiting, {running} running.
errors_summary_unknown: This reading did not say whether YA-WAMF is working, so no state is claimed.
errors_subsystems_unread: Nothing to show until a health reading has loaded.
errors_activity_unread: Activity cannot be shown until a health reading has loaded.
errors_clear_failed: The error history could not be cleared. Try again; if it keeps failing, check that YA-WAMF is running.

classify_snapshot_timeout.title: A Frigate event was dropped because naming its snapshot took too long.
classify_snapshot_timeout.next: The model may be overloaded. Check Resource use above, or choose a lighter model in Settings → Identifying birds.

classify_snapshot_overloaded.title: A Frigate event was dropped because the model was too busy.
classify_snapshot_overloaded.next: Check Resource use above. If it happens often, choose a lighter model in Settings → Identifying birds.

classify_snapshot_unavailable.title: A Frigate event was dropped because Frigate had no snapshot for it.
classify_snapshot_unavailable.next: Birds that fly past briefly often leave no snapshot in Frigate. If this happens often, check that snapshots are enabled for the camera in Frigate.

classifier_empty_results.title: A Frigate event was dropped because the model gave no answer.
classifier_empty_results.next: Check that a model is loaded in Settings → Identifying birds.

save_and_notify_failed.title: A visit was named but could not be saved.
save_and_notify_failed.next: Check that the data folder has free space and can be written to.

stale_job.title: A background job stopped making progress.
stale_job.next: It is shown on Notifications. Start it again from there, or from the Settings tab that runs it.

generic.title: A processing step failed in a way YA-WAMF does not recognise.
generic.next: YA-WAMF cannot say what caused it; the exact error is under Technical details. If it happens again, capture a diagnostics bundle below and report it.

stage_failure.title: A Frigate event could not be processed because one of its steps failed.
stage_failure.next: If it keeps happening, copy the Technical details into a GitHub issue.

stage_timeout.title: A processing step took too long and was stopped.
stage_timeout.next: The model or Frigate may be overloaded. Check Resource use above.

classify_snapshot_lease_expired.title: Naming a snapshot took too long and timed out before finishing.
classify_snapshot_lease_expired.next: The model may be overloaded. Check Resource use above, or choose a lighter model in Settings → Identifying birds.

live_event_stale.title: A Frigate event arrived too late to name live.
live_event_stale.next: Check that the system clock is accurate and that MQTT is not backed up.

live_event_coalesced.title: Duplicate live updates from Frigate for the same visit were merged.
live_event_coalesced.next: No action needed unless visits are missing; YA-WAMF skips duplicate in-flight work.

recovery_lookup_failed.title: YA-WAMF could not check the database while catching up on a Frigate update.
recovery_lookup_failed.next: If this repeats, check Database above and confirm the data folder is writable.

update_recovery_cooldown.title: Retrying a Frigate update was paused briefly to avoid repeating work.
update_recovery_cooldown.next: YA-WAMF will try again when the visit ends. No action needed unless visits are missing.

false_positive_ignored.title: A follow-up Frigate update was skipped because Frigate marked it as a false positive.
false_positive_ignored.next: No action needed; YA-WAMF ignores further updates for dismissed Frigate events.

nest_mode_dedupe.title: A repeat visit on a nest camera was skipped by nest mode.
nest_mode_dedupe.next: Adjust nest mode deduplication in Settings → Cameras & connection if you want every visit recorded.

frigate_missing_marked.title: Older visits were marked as missing in Frigate while keeping your local records.
frigate_missing_marked.next: This is your missing-media policy running normally as Frigate ages out old clips.

frigate_missing_deleted.title: Older visits whose Frigate media expired were removed according to your policy.
frigate_missing_deleted.next: Change the missing-media policy in Settings → Storage & upkeep if you prefer to keep local records.

frigate_missing_kept.title: Older visits no longer have media in Frigate and were kept unchanged.
frigate_missing_kept.next: This is your missing-media policy running normally as Frigate ages out old clips.

frigate_went_offline.title: Frigate reported itself offline over MQTT.
frigate_went_offline.next: Check that Frigate is running and connected to your MQTT broker.

video_circuit_open.title: Automatic video analysis paused briefly after repeated failures.
video_circuit_open.next: It resumes on its own after the cooldown. Check Frigate recordings and Resource use above if it keeps pausing.

video_queue_full.title: A visit skipped automatic video analysis because the video queue was full.
video_queue_full.next: Check Resource use above. If visits arrive faster than video can finish, choose a lighter model or lower video concurrency.

video_timeout.title: Analysing a visit's video clip took too long and was stopped.
video_timeout.next: Check Resource use above and confirm Frigate serves clips promptly.

video_cancelled.title: Video analysis for a visit was cancelled before it finished.
video_cancelled.next: This usually happens during a restart or model reload. You can re-run video analysis from the visit.

video_exception.title: Analysing a visit's video clip stopped with a processing error.
video_exception.next: Check Technical details below. If it repeats, capture a diagnostics bundle and report it.

video_photo_update.title: Video analysis finished, but saving the updated snapshot photo failed.
video_photo_update.next: Check that the data folder has free space and can be written to.

video_retry_after_worker_failure.title: Video analysis retried a clip after its worker restarted.
video_retry_after_worker_failure.next: Check Resource use above. If workers keep restarting, choose a lighter model or switch hardware acceleration.

clip_unavailable.title: Frigate no longer had the recording or clip needed for video analysis.
clip_unavailable.next: Increase clip or recording retention in Frigate if you want video analysis to reach older visits.

maintenance_held_back.title: Background analysis paused so live visits could be named first.
maintenance_held_back.next: It resumes on its own when live feeder traffic eases.

job_failed.title: A background job stopped with an error before finishing.
job_failed.next: Check Technical details below, then start the job again from Settings or Notifications.

job_timeout.title: A background job or notification timed out before finishing.
job_timeout.next: Check that external services are reachable and retry the job if needed.

fetch_snapshot_failed.title: Backfill could not fetch a snapshot from Frigate.
fetch_snapshot_failed.next: Confirm Frigate is reachable and still holds snapshots for the selected date range.

snapshot_cache_failed.title: Backfill could not save a copy of a snapshot to disk.
snapshot_cache_failed.next: Check that the media cache folder has free space and write permission.

rfdetr_cpu_fallback.title: The bird finder fell back to the CPU because the hardware accelerator could not run it.
rfdetr_cpu_fallback.next: Identification still works, though more slowly. Check Hardware settings or choose a lighter bird finder.

bird_finder_worker_crash.title: The bird finder worker crashed or had to be restarted while cropping a photo.
bird_finder_worker_crash.next: YA-WAMF restarted the worker automatically. If this repeats, switch the bird finder device in Settings → Identifying birds.

native_cpu_recovery.title: The model worker switched to the CPU to recover from a hardware runtime failure.
native_cpu_recovery.next: Visits are still being named on the CPU. Check Hardware settings and GPU or NPU drivers if you expect hardware acceleration.

worker_circuit_open.title: A model worker paused briefly after repeated failures.
worker_circuit_open.next: It retries automatically after a short cooldown. Check Resource use and Hardware settings if it keeps happening.

worker_recovering.title: The live model worker is recovering after a slowdown or failure.
worker_recovering.next: Check Resource use above. It clears once live naming is steady again.

hardware_decode_fallback.title: Motion recordings fell back from GPU decoding to the CPU.
hardware_decode_fallback.next: Motion capture continues on the CPU. Check GPU device access in Docker if you want hardware decoding.

retention_paused_daily_totals.title: Automatic history cleanup paused because daily counts could not be saved first.
retention_paused_daily_totals.next: No visits were deleted. Check database health and free disk space; cleanup will retry on its next run.

notification_queue_full.title: A notification was dropped because the send queue was full.
notification_queue_full.next: Check that your notification channels respond promptly in Settings → Notifications.

notification_loop_reset.title: Queued notifications were dropped when the notification worker restarted.
notification_loop_reset.next: Check Settings → Notifications if recent alerts did not arrive.

activity_waiting_live_priority: Waiting while new visits are named
analyze_unknowns_batch_label: Up to {queueLimit} at a time, from the newest {scanLimit}
backfill_nothing_to_check: Nothing in this range to check
backfill_reason_nothing_in_range: Frigate has nothing in this range.
backfill_reason_weather_unavailable: The weather archive has no data for this range.

health_dismiss.effect: Hides this for everyone on this install. Live checks carry on, and it shows again if it happens again.
health_dismiss.live_note: Clears by itself when the check passes.
health_dismiss.dismissed_note: Hidden for everyone on this install. Live checks carry on, and an item shows again if it happens again. Clear error history removes these too.
health_dismiss.dismissed_status: Dismissed. It shows again if it happens again.
health_dismiss.dismiss_failed: That could not be dismissed. Try again; if it keeps failing, check that YA-WAMF is running.
health_dismiss.restore_failed: That could not be restored. Try again; if it keeps failing, check that YA-WAMF is running.
health_dismiss.happened_again: It happened again while this page was open, so it is still listed. Dismiss it again to hide the newer occurrence too.
health_dismiss.already_cleared: This had already left the error history, for example after Clear error history or a restart, so there was nothing to dismiss.
health_dismiss.earlier_empty_with_dismissed: {count, plural, one {Nothing else has cleared; # dismissed incident is listed below.} other {Nothing else has cleared; # dismissed incidents are listed below.}}
health_dismiss.backend_empty_with_dismissed: {count, plural, one {The backend has recorded nothing else; # dismissed item is listed below.} other {The backend has recorded nothing else; # dismissed items are listed below.}} Connection problems are listed at the top of this page, not here.

errors_incident_meta: {count, plural, one {Happened once · {at}} other {Happened # times · last {at}}}
